# Ricardo Morim

> AI Software Engineer at Critical Manufacturing, in the R&D Platform Engineering team, based in Porto, Portugal. Works on AI engineering, AI security, agentic workflows and secure software development.

Ricardo builds AI systems, agents and automations, integrating security throughout the software development lifecycle.

Experience: AI Software Engineer at Critical Manufacturing (current); Application Security Analyst at Celfocus, primary for AI Security and Vulnerability Management; main developer of the InnovatWeb applications and shared CI/CD platform; software engineering internship at INESC TEC on augmented reality indoor navigation.

Education: BSc in Informatics Engineering and Master's in Artificial Intelligence Engineering (in progress) at Instituto Superior de Engenharia do Porto (ISEP). AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.

## Projects

- [Agentic Assurance](https://www.ricardomorim.com/projects/agentic-assurance): harness for agentic software engineering with executable security contracts
- [Chess AI Engine](https://www.ricardomorim.com/projects/chess-ai): chess reinforcement learning with Monte Carlo Tree Search and dual-head residual networks
- [Authentication Library](https://www.ricardomorim.com/projects/auth-library): Spring Boot authentication library published on Maven Central
